title: Your Phone Bill Has 11 Hidden Fees Stealing $3,360
hook: Your carrier advertised $45 a month. Your actual bill is $73. That $28 gap has a name — and it's fully legal.
angle: Wireless carriers deliberately split pricing into 'base rate' and fees so they can advertise a number that nobody actually pays — and regulators let them do it
audience: Anyone with a cell phone bill — especially people who've never questioned the gap between the advertised price and what they actually pay
key_numbers: $28 average monthly gap between advertised and actual phone bill
11 distinct line-item fees buried in the average wireless bill
$3,360 extra paid over 10 years per line above the advertised price
